USDOT Office of the Secretary, Departmental Guidance on Valuation of Travel Time in Economic Analysis (1997; Rev.1 2003; Rev.2 2016): local personal travel = 50% of hourly income, plausible range 35-60%

U-M Student Employment Office: $15/h floor for all on-campus temporary and student positions since 2022-08-21 (SEO newsletter fall 2022); Michigan minimum wage $13.73 from 2026-01-01 (michigan.gov/leo), $15.00 from 2027-01-01; postings seen up to ~$18.75

Computed 0.5 x $15/h (USDOT share x U-M student wage floor). Range: 0.35 x $13.73 = $4.81 to 1.0 x $15 (full wage: student who would otherwise work). Student VOT studies span roughly EUR1.4-18/h (Trieste RP/SP) and $6-23/h (US SP studies)
Definition (numeraire)

Wardman et al. worldwide meta-analysis of time multipliers (2872 multipliers, 606 studies, 52 countries, 1963-2023; indexed TRID 2026): supports reducing the conventional 2.0 to 1.75 (RP emphasis) or 1.50 (SP emphasis). USDOT guidance: walk/wait/transfer at 100% of wage vs 50% for in-vehicle => 2.0.
Same sources as walk (Wardman worldwide meta-analysis 1.5-1.75; USDOT 2.0; Abrantes & Wardman 2011 <2)
No verified cycling-time multiplier found this session; set equal to in-vehicle time

Garcia-Martinez et al. (2018) Transp. Res. A 114:52-66, Madrid SP: pure transfer penalty = 15.2-17.7 in-vehicle minutes (excluding walk/wait). Currie (2005) J. Public Transp. 8(1): review avg bus-bus transfer penalty ~22 min (range 5-50), not netting out walk/wait

Small (1982) AER 72(3):467-479 scheduling model; Small's own bottleneck review summarizes his estimates as approx beta/alpha = 0.5 (early) and gamma/alpha = 2 (late). Wardman, Chintakayala & de Jong (2016) Transp. Res. A 94:93-111 also meta-analyse schedule-delay-early/late values

Physical slowdown: Fossum (winter pavement, Norway) ~+1 min/km on best winter surface, ~+2 min/km on clean ice vs bare pavement (~+8-17% at 12 min/km); computer-vision study in a cold region: speed -0.102 m/s on snow cover (~-8% at 1.3 m/s). Discomfort: 2026 preprint DCE finds per-minute WTP for tim

No study found that prices walking after dark in $/min. Context: Gallup (2023 release) 40% of US adults afraid to walk alone at night within a mile of home; women 53% vs men 26%. Lighting/reassurance literature (Fotios et al.) shows route avoidance after dark but no time-equivalent
Project day-tour rule (concepts/final-recommendation.md v2): go home between events only if gap > round trip + this slack

Project rule (final-recommendation.md v2). Theory: with schedule-delay costs beta (early) and gamma (late), the cost-minimizing on-time probability is gamma/(beta+gamma) ~= 2/(0.5+2) = 0.8 (Small 1982; Noland & Small 1995)
Arithmetic: 365.25 days / 12 months / 7 days

U-M Board of Regents, proposed Ann Arbor calendar 2026-27 (regents.umich.edu meeting 09-2025, via search extract): fall classes begin Mon 2026-08-31; 69 class days in fall and 69 in winter. 69/5 = 13.8 class weeks + ~1 week of exams/study days per term
